description: This file provides Korean (ko) localization texts for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user input is too long, specifying the number of characters to delete.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user input is too short, specifying the number of characters needed.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while a search is in progress.
